title: Santa Fe Argentina Licitaciones - Tender Delta API
description: Scrape and monitor every public tender of Santa Fe Province, Argentina: licitaciones, concursos and contrataciones directas of ministries, hospitals and SAMCOs, with buyer, budget, deadlines, rubros, expediente and pliego/circular/acta PDF links.
